mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CONTENT_SHARES s WHERE s.CONTENT_TYPE = #{contentType} AND s.CONTENT_ID = #{contentId} AND s.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND s.TARGET_ID = s.OWNER_ID AND s.SHARED_BY = s.OWNER_ID AND UPPER(NVL(s.PERMISSION_TYPE, 'VIEW')) = 'VIEW' AND s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') = 'ACCEPTED'
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO CONTENT_SHARES s USING ( SELECT #{contentType} CONTENT_TYPE, #{contentId} CONTENT_ID, #{ownerId} OWNER_ID FROM DUAL ) x ON (s.CONTENT_TYPE = x.CONTENT_TYPE AND s.CONTENT_ID = x.CONTENT_ID AND s.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND s.TARGET_ID = x.OWNER_ID AND s.SHARED_BY = x.OWNER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET s.PERMISSION_TYPE = 'VIEW', s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y', s.SHARE_STATUS = 'ACCEPTED', s.RESPONDED_BY = x.OWNER_ID, s.RESPONDED_AT = SYSDATE, s.EXPIRES_AT = NULL, s.UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( SHARE_ID, CONTENT_TYPE, CONTENT_ID, OWNER_ID, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, PERMISSION_TYPE, SHARED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, EXPIRES_AT, ACTIVE_YN, SHARE_STATUS, RESPONDED_BY, RESPONDED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_CONTENT_SHARE_ID.NEXTVAL, x.CONTENT_TYPE, x.CONTENT_ID, x.OWNER_ID, 'USER', x.OWNER_ID, 'VIEW', x.OWNER_ID, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, NULL, 'Y', 'ACCEPTED', x.OWNER_ID, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT n.NOTE_ID AS CONTENT_ID FROM NOTES n WHERE #{contentType}='NOTE' AND n.NOTE_ID=#{contentId} AND ( (UPPER(n.SCOPE_TYPE)='WS' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WORKSPACES w LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBERS wm ON wm.WS_ID=w.WS_ID AND wm.USER_ID=#{userId} WHERE w.WS_ID=n.WS_ID AND (w.OWNER_ID=#{userId} OR wm.USER_ID IS NOT NULL) )) OR (UPPER(n.SCOPE_TYPE) IN ('PROJ','PROJECT') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROJECTS pr LEFT JOIN PROJ_MEMBERS pm ON pm.PROJ_ID=pr.PROJ_ID AND pm.USER_ID=#{userId} WHERE pr.PROJ_ID=n.PROJ_ID AND pr.WS_ID IS NOT NULL AND (pr.LEADER_ID=#{userId} OR pm.USER_ID IS NOT NULL) )) ) UNION ALL SELECT pp.POST_ID FROM PHOTO_POSTS pp WHERE #{contentType}='PHOTO' AND pp.POST_ID=#{contentId} AND NVL(pp.DELETED_YN,'N')='N' AND ( (UPPER(pp.SCOPE_TYPE) IN ('WORKSPACE','WS','GROUP') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WORKSPACES w LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBERS wm ON wm.WS_ID=w.WS_ID AND wm.USER_ID=#{userId} WHERE w.WS_ID=pp.SCOPE_ID AND (w.OWNER_ID=#{userId} OR wm.USER_ID IS NOT NULL) )) OR (UPPER(pp.SCOPE_TYPE)='PROJECT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROJECTS pr LEFT JOIN PROJ_MEMBERS pm ON pm.PROJ_ID=pr.PROJ_ID AND pm.USER_ID=#{userId} WHERE pr.PROJ_ID=pp.SCOPE_ID AND pr.WS_ID IS NOT NULL AND (pr.LEADER_ID=#{userId} OR pm.USER_ID IS NOT NULL) )) ) UNION ALL SELECT f.CONTENT_FILE_ID FROM CONTENT_FILES f WHERE #{contentType}='FILE' AND f.CONTENT_FILE_ID=#{contentId} AND NVL(f.DELETED_YN,'N')='N' AND ( (UPPER(f.SCOPE_TYPE)='GROUP' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WORKSPACES w LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBERS wm ON wm.WS_ID=w.WS_ID AND wm.USER_ID=#{userId} WHERE w.WS_ID=f.WS_ID AND (w.OWNER_ID=#{userId} OR wm.USER_ID IS NOT NULL) )) OR (UPPER(f.SCOPE_TYPE)='PROJECT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROJECTS pr LEFT JOIN PROJ_MEMBERS pm ON pm.PROJ_ID=pr.PROJ_ID AND pm.USER_ID=#{userId} WHERE pr.PROJ_ID=f.PROJ_ID AND pr.WS_ID IS NOT NULL AND (pr.LEADER_ID=#{userId} OR pm.USER_ID IS NOT NULL) )) ) )

JOIN WS_MEMBERS wm ON wm.WS_ID=w.WS_ID AND wm.USER_ID=#{userId} WHERE w.WS_ID=n.WS_ID AND (w.OWNER_ID=#{userId} OR UPPER(NVL(wm.WS_ROLE,'MEMBER'))='ADMIN') )) OR (UPPER(n.SCOPE_TYPE) IN (pr.LEADER_ID=#{userId} OR UPPER(NVL(pm.PROJ_ROLE,'MEMBER')) IN ('ADMIN','LEADER','OWNER','PM')) )) ) UNION ALL SELECT pp.POST_ID FROM PHOTO_POSTS pp WHERE #{contentType}='PHOTO' AND wm.USER_ID=#{userId} WHERE w.WS_ID=pp.SCOPE_ID AND (w.OWNER_ID=#{userId} OR UPPER(NVL(wm.WS_ROLE,'MEMBER'))='ADMIN') )) OR (UPPER(pp.SCOPE_TYPE)='PROJECT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROJECTS pr LEFT ('ADMIN','LEADER','OWNER','PM')) )) ) UNION ALL SELECT f.CONTENT_FILE_ID FROM CONTENT_FILES f WHERE #{contentType}='FILE' AND f.CONTENT_FILE_ID=#{contentId} AND NVL(f.DELETED_YN,'N')='N' AND ( (UPPER(f.SCOPE_TYPE)='GROUP' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WORKSPACES w LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBERS wm ON wm.WS_ID=w.WS_ID AND wm.USER_ID=#{userId} WHERE w.WS_ID=f.WS_ID AND (w.OWNER_ID=#{userId} OR UPPER(NVL(wm.WS_ROLE,'MEMBER'))='ADMIN') )) OR (UPPER(f.SCOPE_TYPE)='PROJECT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROJECTS pr LEFT JOIN PROJ_MEMBERS pm ON pm.PROJ_ID=pr.PROJ_ID AND pm.USER_ID=#{userId} WHERE pr.PROJ_ID=f.PROJ_ID AND pr.WS_ID IS NOT NULL AND (pr.LEADER_ID=#{userId} OR UPPER(NVL(pm.PROJ_ROLE,'MEMBER')) IN ('ADMIN','LEADER','OWNER','PM')) )) ) )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT n.NOTE_ID AS CONTENT_ID FROM NOTES n WHERE #{contentType}='NOTE' AND n.NOTE_ID=#{contentId} AND (n.USER_ID=#{userId} OR ) UNION ALL SELECT pp.POST_ID AS CONTENT_ID FROM PHOTO_POSTS pp WHERE #{contentType}='PHOTO' AND pp.POST_ID=#{contentId} AND NVL(pp.DELETED_YN,'N')='N' AND (pp.CREATED_BY=#{userId} OR ) UNION ALL SELECT f.CONTENT_FILE_ID AS CONTENT_ID FROM CONTENT_FILES f WHERE #{contentType}='FILE' AND f.CONTENT_FILE_ID=#{contentId} AND NVL(f.DELETED_YN,'N')='N' AND (f.CREATED_BY=#{userId} OR ) )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT n.NOTE_ID AS CONTENT_ID FROM NOTES n WHERE #{contentType}='NOTE' AND n.NOTE_ID=#{contentId} AND ( (UPPER(n.SCOPE_TYPE)='WS' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WORKSPACES w LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBERS wm ON wm.WS_ID=w.WS_ID AND wm.USER_ID=#{targetUserId} WHERE w.WS_ID=n.WS_ID AND (w.OWNER_ID=#{targetUserId} OR wm.USER_ID IS NOT NULL) )) OR (UPPER(n.SCOPE_TYPE) IN ('PROJ','PROJECT') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROJECTS pr LEFT JOIN PROJ_MEMBERS pm ON pm.PROJ_ID=pr.PROJ_ID AND pm.USER_ID=#{targetUserId} WHERE pr.PROJ_ID=n.PROJ_ID AND (pr.LEADER_ID=#{targetUserId} OR pm.USER_ID IS NOT NULL) )) ) UNION ALL SELECT pp.POST_ID FROM PHOTO_POSTS pp WHERE #{contentType}='PHOTO' AND pp.POST_ID=#{contentId} AND ( (UPPER(pp.SCOPE_TYPE) IN ('WORKSPACE','WS','GROUP') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WORKSPACES w LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBERS wm ON wm.WS_ID=w.WS_ID AND wm.USER_ID=#{targetUserId} WHERE w.WS_ID=pp.SCOPE_ID AND (w.OWNER_ID=#{targetUserId} OR wm.USER_ID IS NOT NULL) )) OR (UPPER(pp.SCOPE_TYPE)='PROJECT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROJECTS pr LEFT JOIN PROJ_MEMBERS pm ON pm.PROJ_ID=pr.PROJ_ID AND pm.USER_ID=#{targetUserId} WHERE pr.PROJ_ID=pp.SCOPE_ID AND (pr.LEADER_ID=#{targetUserId} OR pm.USER_ID IS NOT NULL) )) ) UNION ALL SELECT f.CONTENT_FILE_ID FROM CONTENT_FILES f WHERE #{contentType}='FILE' AND f.CONTENT_FILE_ID=#{contentId} AND ( (UPPER(f.SCOPE_TYPE)='GROUP' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WORKSPACES w LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBERS wm ON wm.WS_ID=w.WS_ID AND wm.USER_ID=#{targetUserId} WHERE w.WS_ID=f.WS_ID AND (w.OWNER_ID=#{targetUserId} OR wm.USER_ID IS NOT NULL) )) OR (UPPER(f.SCOPE_TYPE)='PROJECT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROJECTS pr LEFT JOIN PROJ_MEMBERS pm ON pm.PROJ_ID=pr.PROJ_ID AND pm.USER_ID=#{targetUserId} WHERE pr.PROJ_ID=f.PROJ_ID AND (pr.LEADER_ID=#{targetUserId} OR pm.USER_ID IS NOT NULL) )) ) )

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT u.USER_ID AS "targetId", NVL(u.USER_NAME,u.EMAIL) AS "targetName", u.EMAIL AS "targetSubtext", u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH AS "profileImagePath" FROM USERS u WHERE NVL(u.STATUS,'ACTIVE')='ACTIVE' AND u.USER_ID != NVL(( SELECT OWNER_ID FROM ( SELECT n.USER_ID OWNER_ID FROM NOTES n WHERE #{contentType}='NOTE' AND n.NOTE_ID=#{contentId} UNION ALL SELECT pp.CREATED_BY OWNER_ID FROM PHOTO_POSTS pp WHERE #{contentType}='PHOTO' AND pp.POST_ID=#{contentId} UNION ALL SELECT f.CREATED_BY OWNER_ID FROM CONTENT_FILES f WHERE #{contentType}='FILE' AND f.CONTENT_FILE_ID=#{contentId} ) WHERE ROWNUM=1 ), -1) AND
AND ( UPPER(NVL(u.USER_NAME,u.EMAIL)) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(u.EMAIL) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
ORDER BY NVL(u.USER_NAME,u.EMAIL),u.EMAIL ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 100
mapper.sql: ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM NOTES n WHERE #{contentType}='NOTE' AND n.NOTE_ID=#{contentId} AND ( (UPPER(n.SCOPE_TYPE)='WS' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WORKSPACES w LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBERS wm ON wm.WS_ID=w.WS_ID AND wm.USER_ID=u.USER_ID WHERE w.WS_ID=n.WS_ID AND (w.OWNER_ID=u.USER_ID OR wm.USER_ID IS NOT NULL) )) OR (UPPER(n.SCOPE_TYPE) IN ('PROJ','PROJECT') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROJECTS pr LEFT JOIN PROJ_MEMBERS pm ON pm.PROJ_ID=pr.PROJ_ID AND pm.USER_ID=u.USER_ID WHERE pr.PROJ_ID=n.PROJ_ID AND (pr.LEADER_ID=u.USER_ID OR pm.USER_ID IS NOT NULL) )) ) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PHOTO_POSTS pp WHERE #{contentType}='PHOTO' AND pp.POST_ID=#{contentId} AND ( (UPPER(pp.SCOPE_TYPE) IN ('WORKSPACE','WS','GROUP') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WORKSPACES w LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBERS wm ON wm.WS_ID=w.WS_ID AND wm.USER_ID=u.USER_ID WHERE w.WS_ID=pp.SCOPE_ID AND (w.OWNER_ID=u.USER_ID OR wm.USER_ID IS NOT NULL) )) OR (UPPER(pp.SCOPE_TYPE)='PROJECT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROJECTS pr LEFT JOIN PROJ_MEMBERS pm ON pm.PROJ_ID=pr.PROJ_ID AND pm.USER_ID=u.USER_ID WHERE pr.PROJ_ID=pp.SCOPE_ID AND (pr.LEADER_ID=u.USER_ID OR pm.USER_ID IS NOT NULL) )) ) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT_FILES f WHERE #{contentType}='FILE' AND f.CONTENT_FILE_ID=#{contentId} AND ( (UPPER(f.SCOPE_TYPE)='GROUP' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WORKSPACES w LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBERS wm ON wm.WS_ID=w.WS_ID AND wm.USER_ID=u.USER_ID WHERE w.WS_ID=f.WS_ID AND (w.OWNER_ID=u.USER_ID OR wm.USER_ID IS NOT NULL) )) OR (UPPER(f.SCOPE_TYPE)='PROJECT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROJECTS pr LEFT JOIN PROJ_MEMBERS pm ON pm.PROJ_ID=pr.PROJ_ID AND pm.USER_ID=u.USER_ID WHERE pr.PROJ_ID=f.PROJ_ID AND (pr.LEADER_ID=u.USER_ID OR pm.USER_ID IS NOT NULL) )) ) ) )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT n.USER_ID AS OWNER_ID FROM NOTES n WHERE #{contentType} = 'NOTE' AND n.NOTE_ID = #{contentId} UNION ALL SELECT p.CREATED_BY AS OWNER_ID FROM PHOTO_POSTS p WHERE #{contentType} = 'PHOTO' AND p.POST_ID = #{contentId} UNION ALL SELECT e.USER_ID AS OWNER_ID FROM EVENTS e WHERE #{contentType} = 'CALENDAR' AND e.EVENT_ID = #{contentId} UNION ALL SELECT f.CREATED_BY AS OWNER_ID FROM CONTENT_FILES f WHERE #{contentType} = 'FILE' AND f.CONTENT_FILE_ID = #{contentId} AND NVL(f.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N' ) x WHERE x.OWNER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CONTENT_SHARES s WHERE s.CONTENT_TYPE = #{contentType} AND s.CONTENT_ID = #{contentId} AND s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') = 'ACCEPTED' AND (s.EXPIRES_AT IS NULL OR s.EXPIRES_AT >= SYSDATE) AND ( (s.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND s.TARGET_ID = #{userId}) OR (s.TARGET_TYPE = 'WS' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WS_MEMBERS wm WHERE wm.WS_ID = s.TARGET_ID AND wm.USER_ID = #{userId})) OR (s.TARGET_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJ_MEMBERS pm WHERE pm.PROJ_ID = s.TARGET_ID AND pm.USER_ID = #{userId})) )

SELECT OWNER_ID FROM ( SELECT n.USER_ID AS OWNER_ID FROM NOTES n WHERE #{contentType} = 'NOTE' AND n.NOTE_ID = #{contentId} UNION ALL SELECT p.CREATED_BY AS OWNER_ID FROM PHOTO_POSTS p WHERE #{contentType} = 'PHOTO' AND p.POST_ID = #{contentId} UNION ALL SELECT e.USER_ID AS OWNER_ID FROM EVENTS e WHERE #{contentType} = 'CALENDAR' AND e.EVENT_ID = #{contentId} UNION ALL SELECT f.CREATED_BY AS OWNER_ID FROM CONTENT_FILES f WHERE #{contentType} = 'FILE' AND f.CONTENT_FILE_ID = #{contentId} AND NVL(f.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N' ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT SRC.CREATED_BY FROM CONTENT_REACTIONS CL JOIN PHOTO_POSTS SRC ON SRC.POST_ID = TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(CL.REACTION_TYPE, 5)) WHERE #{contentType} = 'PHOTO' AND CL.CONTENT_TYPE = 'PHOTO_COLLECT_LINK' AND CL.CONTENT_ID = #{contentId} AND CL.REACTION_TYPE LIKE 'SRC_%' AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT n.NOTE_ID AS CONTENT_ID FROM NOTES n LEFT JOIN PROJECTS p ON p.PROJ_ID = n.PROJ_ID WHERE #{contentType} = 'NOTE' AND n.NOTE_ID = #{contentId} AND n.USER_ID = #{userId} AND (UPPER(NVL(n.SCOPE_TYPE, 'PRIVATE')) IN ('PRIVATE', 'PERSONAL') OR (UPPER(n.SCOPE_TYPE) = 'PROJECT' AND p.WS_ID IS NULL)) UNION ALL SELECT pp.POST_ID AS CONTENT_ID FROM PHOTO_POSTS pp LEFT JOIN PROJECTS p ON UPPER(pp.SCOPE_TYPE) = 'PROJECT' AND p.PROJ_ID = pp.SCOPE_ID WHERE #{contentType} = 'PHOTO' AND pp.POST_ID = #{contentId} AND pp.CREATED_BY = #{userId} AND NVL(pp.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND (UPPER(NVL(pp.SCOPE_TYPE, 'PERSONAL')) = 'PERSONAL' OR (UPPER(pp.SCOPE_TYPE) = 'PROJECT' AND p.WS_ID IS NULL)) UNION ALL SELECT f.CONTENT_FILE_ID AS CONTENT_ID FROM CONTENT_FILES f LEFT JOIN PROJECTS p ON UPPER(f.SCOPE_TYPE) = 'PROJECT' AND p.PROJ_ID = f.PROJ_ID WHERE #{contentType} = 'FILE' AND f.CONTENT_FILE_ID = #{contentId} AND f.CREATED_BY = #{userId} AND NVL(f.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND (UPPER(NVL(f.SCOPE_TYPE, 'PERSONAL')) = 'PERSONAL' OR (UPPER(f.SCOPE_TYPE) = 'PROJECT' AND p.WS_ID IS NULL)) )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT p.POST_ID AS CONTENT_ID FROM PHOTO_POSTS p WHERE #{contentType} = 'PHOTO' AND p.POST_ID = #{contentId} AND UPPER(NVL(p.VISIBILITY_TYPE, 'PRIVATE')) = 'FRIENDS' AND NVL(p.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND p.CREATED_BY <> #{userId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_FRIENDS mf WHERE mf.STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' AND ((mf.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} AND mf.ADDRESSEE_ID = p.CREATED_BY) OR (mf.ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId} AND mf.REQUESTER_ID = p.CREATED_BY)) ) UNION ALL SELECT n.NOTE_ID AS CONTENT_ID FROM NOTES n WHERE #{contentType} = 'NOTE' AND n.NOTE_ID = #{contentId} AND NVL(n.MOYO_PUBLIC_YN, 'N') = 'Y' AND n.USER_ID <> #{userId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_FRIENDS mf WHERE mf.STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' AND ((mf.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} AND mf.ADDRESSEE_ID = n.USER_ID) OR (mf.ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId} AND mf.REQUESTER_ID = n.USER_ID)) ) )

SELECT s.SHARE_ID, s.CONTENT_TYPE, s.CONTENT_ID, s.OWNER_ID, s.TARGET_TYPE, s.TARGET_ID, s.PERMISSION_TYPE, s.SHARED_BY, s.CREATED_AT, s.EXPIRES_AT, s.ACTIVE_YN, NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') AS SHARE_STATUS, s.RESPONDED_BY, s.RESPONDED_AT, ru.USER_NAME AS REQUESTER_NAME, ru.EMAIL AS REQUESTER_EMAIL, CASE s.TARGET_TYPE WHEN 'USER' THEN u.USER_NAME WHEN 'WS' THEN w.WS_NAME WHEN 'PROJ' THEN p.PROJ_NAME END AS TARGET_NAME, CASE s.TARGET_TYPE WHEN 'USER' THEN u.EMAIL WHEN 'WS' THEN '워크스페이스' WHEN 'PROJ' THEN w2.WS_NAME END AS TARGET_SUBTEXT FROM CONTENT_SHARES s LEFT JOIN USERS ru ON ru.USER_ID = s.SHARED_BY LEFT JOIN USERS u ON s.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND u.USER_ID = s.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN WORKSPACES w ON s.TARGET_TYPE = 'WS' AND w.WS_ID = s.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN PROJECTS p ON s.TARGET_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND p.PROJ_ID = s.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN WORKSPACES w2 ON p.WS_ID = w2.WS_ID WHERE s.CONTENT_TYPE = #{contentType} AND s.CONTENT_ID = #{contentId} AND NOT (s.TARGET_TYPE='USER' AND s.TARGET_ID=s.OWNER_ID AND s.SHARED_BY=s.OWNER_ID AND UPPER(NVL(s.PERMISSION_TYPE,'VIEW'))='VIEW') AND s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED') AND (s.EXPIRES_AT IS NULL OR s.EXPIRES_AT >= SYSDATE) ORDER BY s.CREATED_AT DESC, s.SHARE_ID DESC

SELECT s.SHARE_ID, s.CONTENT_TYPE, s.CONTENT_ID, s.OWNER_ID, s.TARGET_TYPE, s.TARGET_ID, s.PERMISSION_TYPE, s.SHARED_BY, s.CREATED_AT, s.EXPIRES_AT, s.ACTIVE_YN, NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') AS SHARE_STATUS, s.RESPONDED_BY, s.RESPONDED_AT, ru.USER_NAME AS REQUESTER_NAME, ru.EMAIL AS REQUESTER_EMAIL, CASE s.TARGET_TYPE WHEN 'USER' THEN u.USER_NAME WHEN 'WS' THEN w.WS_NAME WHEN 'PROJ' THEN p.PROJ_NAME END AS TARGET_NAME, CASE s.TARGET_TYPE WHEN 'USER' THEN u.EMAIL WHEN 'WS' THEN '그룹' WHEN 'PROJ' THEN w2.WS_NAME END AS TARGET_SUBTEXT, CASE WHEN s.OWNER_ID = #{userId} OR s.SHARED_BY = #{userId} THEN 'Y' WHEN s.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND s.TARGET_ID = #{userId} THEN 'Y' WHEN s.TARGET_TYPE = 'WS' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WORKSPACES wown WHERE wown.WS_ID = s.TARGET_ID AND wown.OWNER_ID = #{userId}) THEN 'Y' WHEN s.TARGET_TYPE = 'WS' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WS_MEMBERS wm2 WHERE wm2.WS_ID = s.TARGET_ID AND wm2.USER_ID = #{userId} AND UPPER(NVL(wm2.WS_ROLE, 'MEMBER')) = 'ADMIN') THEN 'Y' WHEN s.TARGET_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJECTS pr WHERE pr.PROJ_ID = s.TARGET_ID AND pr.LEADER_ID = #{userId}) THEN 'Y' WHEN s.TARGET_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJ_MEMBERS pm2 WHERE pm2.PROJ_ID = s.TARGET_ID AND pm2.USER_ID = #{userId} AND UPPER(NVL(pm2.PROJ_ROLE, 'MEMBER')) IN ('ADMIN','LEADER','OWNER','PM')) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS RELEASEABLE_YN FROM CONTENT_SHARES s LEFT JOIN USERS ru ON ru.USER_ID = s.SHARED_BY LEFT JOIN USERS u ON s.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND u.USER_ID = s.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN WORKSPACES w ON s.TARGET_TYPE = 'WS' AND w.WS_ID = s.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN PROJECTS p ON s.TARGET_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND p.PROJ_ID = s.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN WORKSPACES w2 ON p.WS_ID = w2.WS_ID WHERE s.CONTENT_TYPE = #{contentType} AND s.CONTENT_ID = #{contentId} AND NOT (s.TARGET_TYPE='USER' AND s.TARGET_ID=s.OWNER_ID AND s.SHARED_BY=s.OWNER_ID AND UPPER(NVL(s.PERMISSION_TYPE,'VIEW'))='VIEW') AND s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') = 'ACCEPTED' AND (s.EXPIRES_AT IS NULL OR s.EXPIRES_AT >= SYSDATE) AND ( (s.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND s.TARGET_ID = #{userId}) OR (s.TARGET_TYPE = 'WS' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WS_MEMBERS wm WHERE wm.WS_ID = s.TARGET_ID AND wm.USER_ID = #{userId})) OR (s.TARGET_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJ_MEMBERS pm WHERE pm.PROJ_ID = s.TARGET_ID AND pm.USER_ID = #{userId})) ) ORDER BY s.CREATED_AT DESC, s.SHARE_ID DESC

SELECT shared_rows.OWNER_ID AS "ownerId", MAX(shared_rows.OWNER_NAME) AS "ownerName", COUNT(DISTINCT shared_rows.CONTENT_ID) AS "contentCount" FROM ( SELECT s.OWNER_ID, u.USER_NAME AS OWNER_NAME, s.CONTENT_ID FROM CONTENT_SHARES s JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = s.OWNER_ID WHERE s.CONTENT_TYPE = #{contentType} AND s.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND s.TARGET_ID = #{userId} AND s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') = 'ACCEPTED' AND (s.EXPIRES_AT IS NULL OR s.EXPIRES_AT >= SYSDATE) AND ( (#{contentType} = 'NOTE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM NOTES n WHERE n.NOTE_ID = s.CONTENT_ID AND n.USER_ID = s.OWNER_ID AND UPPER(NVL(n.SCOPE_TYPE, 'PRIVATE')) IN ('PRIVATE', 'PERSONAL') AND NVL(n.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N' )) OR (#{contentType} = 'PHOTO' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PHOTO_POSTS pp WHERE pp.POST_ID = s.CONTENT_ID AND pp.CREATED_BY = s.OWNER_ID AND UPPER(NVL(pp.SCOPE_TYPE, 'PERSONAL')) = 'PERSONAL' AND NVL(pp.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N' )) OR (#{contentType} = 'FILE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT_FILES f WHERE f.CONTENT_FILE_ID = s.CONTENT_ID AND f.OWNER_USER_ID = s.OWNER_ID AND UPPER(NVL(f.SCOPE_TYPE, 'PERSONAL')) = 'PERSONAL' AND NVL(f.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N' )) ) UNION ALL SELECT e.USER_ID AS OWNER_ID, u.USER_NAME AS OWNER_NAME, cri.CONTENT_ID FROM CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS cri JOIN CONTENT_RECORD_TARGETS crt ON crt.RECORD_TARGET_ID = cri.RECORD_TARGET_ID JOIN EVENTS e ON crt.TARGET_TYPE = 'EVENT' AND crt.TARGET_ID = e.EVENT_ID JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = e.USER_ID WHERE cri.RECORD_TYPE = #{contentType} AND cri.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND crt.TARGET_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND crt.SCOPE_TYPE = 'PERSONAL' AND e.ITEM_TYPE = 'PRIVATE' AND e.USER_ID != #{userId} AND NVL(e.RECORD_ENABLED_YN, 'N') = 'Y' AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EVENT_ATTENDEES ea WHERE ea.EVENT_ID = e.EVENT_ID mapper.insert: MERGE INTO CONTENT_SHARES s USING ( SELECT #{contentType} CONTENT_TYPE, #{contentId} CONTENT_ID, #{targetType} TARGET_TYPE, #{targetId} TARGET_ID FROM DUAL ) x ON (s.CONTENT_TYPE = x.CONTENT_TYPE AND s.CONTENT_ID = x.CONTENT_ID AND s.TARGET_TYPE = x.TARGET_TYPE AND s.TARGET_ID = x.TARGET_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET s.PERMISSION_TYPE = #{permissionType}, s.SHARED_BY = CASE WHEN s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED') THEN s.SHARED_BY ELSE #{sharedBy} END, s.OWNER_ID = #{ownerId}, s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y', s.SHARE_STATUS = CASE WHEN s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED') THEN s.SHARE_STATUS ELSE 'PENDING' END, s.RESPONDED_BY = CASE WHEN s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') = 'ACCEPTED' THEN s.RESPONDED_BY ELSE NULL END, s.RESPONDED_AT = CASE WHEN s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') = 'ACCEPTED' THEN s.RESPONDED_AT ELSE NULL END, s.EXPIRES_AT = NULL, s.UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( SHARE_ID, CONTENT_TYPE, CONTENT_ID, OWNER_ID, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, PERMISSION_TYPE, SHARED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, EXPIRES_AT, ACTIVE_YN, SHARE_STATUS, RESPONDED_BY, RESPONDED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_CONTENT_SHARE_ID.NEXTVAL, #{contentType}, #{contentId}, #{ownerId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{permissionType}, #{sharedBy}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, NULL, 'Y', 'PENDING', NULL, NULL )

MERGE INTO CONTENT_SHARES s USING ( SELECT #{contentType} CONTENT_TYPE, #{contentId} CONTENT_ID, #{targetType} TARGET_TYPE, #{targetId} TARGET_ID FROM DUAL ) x ON (s.CONTENT_TYPE = x.CONTENT_TYPE AND s.CONTENT_ID = x.CONTENT_ID AND s.TARGET_TYPE = x.TARGET_TYPE AND s.TARGET_ID = x.TARGET_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET s.PERMISSION_TYPE = #{permissionType}, s.SHARED_BY = CASE WHEN s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED') THEN s.SHARED_BY ELSE #{sharedBy} END, s.OWNER_ID = #{ownerId}, s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y', s.SHARE_STATUS = CASE WHEN s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED') THEN s.SHARE_STATUS ELSE 'PENDING' END, s.CREATED_AT = CASE WHEN s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED') THEN s.CREATED_AT ELSE NVL(#{createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, SYSDATE) END, s.RESPONDED_BY = CASE WHEN s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED') THEN s.RESPONDED_BY ELSE NULL END, s.RESPONDED_AT = CASE WHEN s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED') THEN s.RESPONDED_AT ELSE NULL END, s.EXPIRES_AT = #{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, s.UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( SHARE_ID, CONTENT_TYPE, CONTENT_ID, OWNER_ID, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, PERMISSION_TYPE, SHARED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, EXPIRES_AT, ACTIVE_YN, SHARE_STATUS, RESPONDED_BY, RESPONDED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_CONTENT_SHARE_ID.NEXTVAL, #{contentType}, #{contentId}, #{ownerId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{permissionType}, #{sharedBy}, NVL(#{createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, SYSDATE), SYSDATE, #{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 'Y', 'PENDING', NULL, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT s.SHARE_ID, s.CONTENT_TYPE, s.CONTENT_ID, s.OWNER_ID, s.TARGET_TYPE, s.TARGET_ID, s.PERMISSION_TYPE, s.SHARED_BY, s.CREATED_AT, s.EXPIRES_AT, s.ACTIVE_YN, NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') AS SHARE_STATUS, s.RESPONDED_BY, s.RESPONDED_AT, CASE s.CONTENT_TYPE WHEN 'PHOTO' THEN NVL(pp.TITLE, '사진 게시물') WHEN 'NOTE' THEN NVL(n.NOTE_TITLE, '노트') WHEN 'CALENDAR' THEN NVL(e.TITLE, '일정') ELSE s.CONTENT_TYPE END AS CONTENT_TITLE, ru.USER_NAME AS REQUESTER_NAME, ru.EMAIL AS REQUESTER_EMAIL, CASE s.TARGET_TYPE WHEN 'USER' THEN tu.USER_NAME WHEN 'WS' THEN tw.WS_NAME WHEN 'PROJ' THEN tp.PROJ_NAME END AS TARGET_NAME, CASE s.TARGET_TYPE WHEN 'USER' THEN tu.EMAIL WHEN 'WS' THEN '그룹' WHEN 'PROJ' THEN tw2.WS_NAME END AS TARGET_SUBTEXT, CASE WHEN s.CONTENT_TYPE = 'CALENDAR' THEN TO_CHAR(e.START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') END AS CALENDAR_START_DT, CASE WHEN s.CONTENT_TYPE = 'CALENDAR' THEN TO_CHAR(e.END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') END AS CALENDAR_END_DT, CASE WHEN s.CONTENT_TYPE = 'CALENDAR' THEN e.LOCATION_TEXT END AS CALENDAR_LOCATION_TEXT, CASE WHEN s.CONTENT_TYPE = 'CALENDAR' THEN e.LOCATION_ADDRESS END AS CALENDAR_LOCATION_ADDRESS, 'N' AS CALENDAR_ATTENDEE_YN FROM CONTENT_SHARES s LEFT JOIN PHOTO_POSTS pp ON s.CONTENT_TYPE = 'PHOTO' AND pp.POST_ID = s.CONTENT_ID LEFT JOIN NOTES n ON s.CONTENT_TYPE = 'NOTE' AND n.NOTE_ID = s.CONTENT_ID LEFT JOIN EVENTS e ON s.CONTENT_TYPE = 'CALENDAR' AND e.EVENT_ID = s.CONTENT_ID LEFT JOIN USERS ru ON ru.USER_ID = s.SHARED_BY LEFT JOIN USERS tu ON s.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND tu.USER_ID = s.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN WORKSPACES tw ON s.TARGET_TYPE = 'WS' AND tw.WS_ID = s.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN PROJECTS tp ON s.TARGET_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND tp.PROJ_ID = s.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN WORKSPACES tw2 ON tp.WS_ID = tw2.WS_ID WHERE s.SHARE_ID = #{shareId}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT u.USER_ID AS "targetId", NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL) AS "targetName", u.EMAIL AS "targetSubtext", u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH AS "profileImagePath" FROM USERS u WHERE u.USER_ID != #{userId} AND NVL(u.STATUS, 'ACTIVE') = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_FRIENDS f WHERE f.STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' AND ( (f.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} AND f.ADDRESSEE_ID = u.USER_ID) OR (f.ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId} AND f.REQUESTER_ID = u.USER_ID) ) )
AND (UPPER(NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL)) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(u.EMAIL) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%')
ORDER BY NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL), u.EMAIL ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 30
